articles.title: Delhi building collapse: PG operator, wife sent to judicial custody
articles.summary: A Delhi court has sent a married couple to 14 days of judicial custody following their arrest in connection with the Satya Niketan building collapse. This tragic incident claimed seven lives, and their son was also remanded. The legal proceedings highlight the ongoing efforts to ensure accountability for the catastrophic collapse, bringing those responsible before the judiciary.

articles.title: Russia to strip contract soldiers of one-off payment if laws violated at home
articles.summary: Russia's defence ministry is reportedly seeking to reclaim portions of one-off payouts previously given to its contract service personnel. This new initiative targets those found guilty of criminal offenses within Russia, indicating a move to enhance accountability and discipline within the military ranks by recovering funds from convicted service members.

articles.title: Ryan Reynolds Would Cameo in LANTERNS and Says He Owes GREEN LANTERN “Everything”
articles.summary: Actor Ryan Reynolds, known for Green Lantern (DC) and Deadpool (Marvel), is reportedly open to revisiting the DC universe. Despite having moved on from his initial DC role, the article suggests he hasn't entirely dismissed a return. This highlights the dynamic nature of actor-franchise relationships in the global entertainment industry, offering insights into potential future film projects and character crossovers.

articles.title: Okay, We Know Who Lanterns' Manhunter Is Now, But That Doesn't Exactly Answer All Of My Questions
